people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

translations.web: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
translations.bsb: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
translations.kjv: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
translations.asv: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their sojournings, wherein they sojourned.
